---
defaults:
  scene:
    transition: fade
video:
  fps: 30
---

::: {.scene component="title" duration="4s" #opening}
The first scene takes no transition.
:::

::: {.scene component="title" duration="2s" transitionDuration="500ms" #second}
The default fade applies.
:::

::: {.scene component="title" duration="3s" transition="cut" #third}
An explicit cut wins.
:::

::: {.scene component="title" duration="4s" transition="fade" transitionDuration="1s" #fourth}
An explicit fade.
:::
